recipes.comment: User-approved finished Fusion Control Bearing. Preserve the user-edited5x5layout exactly: one nickel frame, eight HSLA rods, four Tough Alloy corner plates, four stainless plates, four tungsten-carbide wear plates and four Allthemodium rods. Start with DU Plating, Radiance cut mounting lands, Brass rubber isolation and Railway board seating. Radiance installs one niobium-titanium electromagnet inside the module. Two copper and two electrum wire applications build sensing/winding links; three resistors form detection/dump branches, three transistors form switching/interlock bank. Paired voltage observers monitor the magnet, valve and thermal link service it, then trim/seal. Whole magnet is installed mid-sequence rather than used as the starting item. One loop, one output. DU replaces former Advanced cover as requested. One loop, one output. User-requested mixed machine tiers and expanded electronics; pending Progression Review only. Accepted 3D model unchanged.
